title: Gluing affine smooth models at a common stage
statement: Given the affine smooth model and comparison data for a finitely presented pullback over a noetherian approximation, there is a later stage j such that the original pullback projection is smooth.

source.place: Tag 0C0C, limits.tex, lemma-descend-smooth, with Situation 081D; affine descent via Tag 0CAQ and comparison via Tag 01ZM(2)-(3)

proof.text: Use the noetherian approximation diagram N.D and its limiting cone N.π. Its index category is small and cofiltered, its transition maps are affine, and every stage is Noetherian and consequently quasi-separated. These properties are already supplied by NoetherianApproximation and the Mathlib Noetherian instances.

Apply Scheme.exists_smooth_stage_of_affine_limit to this diagram, p, the smooth limit morphism f, and the given pullback square H. It returns exactly a j : Over i for which pullback.snd p (N.D.map j.hom) is smooth. This argument does not need hmodel or transport smoothness along its bare scheme isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0C0C, specialized from the existing general affine-transition-limit theorem lem-sbc-affine-limit-smooth-stage
proof_origin.note: A2: the original affine-model compatibility is not needed; the existing general theorem applies to f and H.

lean.statement:
theorem Scheme.NoetherianApproximation.smooth_stage_of_affine_models
    {S : Scheme.{u}} (N : S.NoetherianApproximation) {i : N.I}
    {Y X : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ N.D.obj i)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation p] [QuasiCompact p] [QuasiSeparated p]
    (f : X ⟶ S) [Smooth f] (a : X ⟶ Y)
    (H : IsPullback a f p (N.π.app i))
    (hmodel : ∃ (j : Over i) (Z : Scheme.{u}) (q : Z ⟶ N.D.obj j.left)
      (_ : LocallyOfFinitePresentation q) (_ : QuasiCompact q) (_ : QuasiSeparated q),
      Smooth q ∧ Nonempty (Z ≅ Limits.pullback p (N.D.map j.hom))) :
    ∃ j : Over i, Smooth (pullback.snd p (N.D.map j.hom))
